question: After the Wei et al. text baseline is trained, how far do precision, recall, and F1 move on 200 held-out texts when those texts are paraphrased and the labels stay the same?

twibot20.reason: The public files are an unlabeled sample (TwiBot-20_sample.json). The original README says the full dataset is not posted and requires permission from shangbin@cs.washington.edu. The official TwiBot-20 split was not used.

dataset.records: Posts.csv text joined to Users.csv isPuppet
dataset.human: isPuppet false and isObserver false (DartPost participants)
dataset.excluded: isObserver true accounts have no posts and are not treated as human labels
dataset.split: stratified holdout of 200 posts, seed 100. This is not an official TwiBot split.

baseline.name: Wei et al. BiLSTM with attention
baseline.deviation: LSTM initial state is zeros. Upstream samples it with torch.randn on every forward pass.
